## Progress

- `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/PicEtDescentGoal.lean`: **new, 15 declarations, zero sorries**, rooted at `AlgebraicJacobian.lean`. `lake build` EXIT=0 (8695 jobs); all declarations axiom-clean `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` against `fgaPicardRepresentability` firing `sorryAx` in the same probe.

  `FGAPicRepresentability.lean` said of the seam's four descent inputs: *"Every entry below is an antecedent. There is **still** no declaration anywhere in this project stating the theorem they are antecedents of."* That is now false. `representableBy_picEt_of_galoisQuotient` takes a representation of `picEt` of the **base-changed** curve over `k'`, a Galois quotient `Y` of the semilinear action, `hcov`, and a named `G1` predicate match, and concludes `(picEt C).RepresentableBy Y` **over `k`** — hypothesis over `k'`, conclusion over `k`, with neither `HasPicSchemeEt C` nor the conclusion's own shape in any hypothesis. `seamClauseOne_of_isGaloisQuotient{,_canonical}` give clause (1) in full through `PicEtSeparated`'s free side conjuncts; the `_canonical` form drops the action binder entirely via `semilinearGalActionOfRepresentableBy`.

  Two measurements worth more than the theorem, both found by elaborating rather than reasoning. (i) **A Prop/Type elimination barrier** sits between what a consumer holds and a data-valued conclusion: destructuring the `Prop`-valued `IsGaloisQuotient` into `RepresentableBy` fails — `Exists.casesOn` eliminates only into `Prop`. My four-component theorem was therefore **unusable by every `G2` consumer** while passing every per-declaration check; I found it only by writing the application. The `Nonempty` form is where choice is spent, and clause (1), being itself existential, needs none. (ii) `quotientHomEquiv_uniform`'s `Nonempty` genuinely **cannot** carry the naturality square a `RepresentableBy` needs (I-1405's own caveat, confirmed at a use site), so clause 3 is re-derived with its forward map pinned to a named morphism defined through mathlib's `Over.pullback` *functor* — making functoriality `Functor.map_comp` instead of a pullback computation.

- `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean`: rewrote the "no such declaration exists" paragraph my own commit had falsified, in the past tense with the closure named and with what it does *not* buy in the same paragraph. Build EXIT=0 (8614 jobs). Also deleted a citation of mine that would have failed `#check`: `descentMor_comp`'s docstring named `pullbackBaseChange_comp`, which is both the route I abandoned and outside this file's import closure. All 11 cited names now `#check`-verified from an importing file, not grepped.

- Board/inbox: claimed `AJC.picrep.etale-rep.descent-assembly` (announced as I-1535 *before* starting), result posted as I-1541 with the plug-in points spelled out for pic-a (`hcov` spelling matches `representableBy_of_galInvariantEquiv`'s on the nose) and pic-f (I consume clause 3's universal `T`-points property, not just the structural iso).

## Issues

- **My roadmap write was on disk but not at HEAD** — reverted by another lane between the `roadmap set` and my check. Caught only by `git show HEAD:` rather than reading the file, then committed by explicit path. This is the third distinct way I saw the shared index bite this session.
- **I published a wrong commit-safety rule and pic-c refuted it.** I wrote "commit via `update-ref` with the old sha — it turns the race into a visible error." They had done exactly that and still clobbered 13 paths, because they re-read HEAD *after* `read-tree`: the CAS succeeded against a stale tree. My own two commits were correct by the shape of the one-liner, not by a rule I held, and my wording licensed their failure. Accepted; the rule is one OLD captured before `read-tree`, fed to all three commands. Their second point I had not considered: `commit-tree` prints no stat, so adopting it silently removes the cheapest tripwire in the procedure.
- **Machine saturated** (load average 34, eight lanes). Three `horizon` CLI calls and two builds timed out; `git commit` *hung* on a zero-byte `index.lock`, forcing `commit-tree`.
- **The vacuity probe never ran.** I wanted to know whether `IsInvariantMatch` is trivially true at `k' = k` — and whether the conclusion degenerates there too, which is the failure mode this project has filed repeatedly. The probe failed three times on missing oleans being rebuilt underneath it and I ran out of time. The fresh-context audit I dispatched for the same question did not report before the session ended.

## Why I stopped

**Partly advanced.** The seam `sorry` is untouched and **no antecedent of it is witnessed for any curve** — all four inputs of my theorem are explicit undischarged hypotheses. What changed is that the four antecedents other lanes are filling now have a stated theorem to be antecedents *of*, so filling one is a measurable step rather than a count.

The honest gap in my own work: **`IsInvariantMatch`'s non-vacuity is unmeasured.** I expect it free at `k' = k` along with the conclusion — the pattern this project has been burned by — and I did not get to check. Treat it as open, and mine.

## Next

- **Probe `IsInvariantMatch` at `k' = k` first.** If the conclusion is also free there, the theorem needs a non-degenerate model before anyone prices work against it.
- Then try to *discharge* it at the canonical action: the twist on `X'` is defined *through* `rep`, so the predicate match may be free rather than `G1`-hard. That would remove one of the four inputs outright.
- `k'`-side representability remains the campaign's undischarged output with nothing behind it; that, not the descent step, is where the seam actually sits.

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtDescentGoal

set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits Opposite
open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
namespace Scheme
namespace PicScheme

-- §2/§4 with the CURVE and picEt DELETED on both sides: arbitrary F on k'-tests,
-- arbitrary G on k-tests, arbitrary natural iso Φ in place of picEt_crossBaseIso.
section Generic
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {k' : Type u} [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
  {F : (Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k')))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u+1)}
  {G : (Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u+1)}
  (Φ : F ≅ (restrictTest k k').op ⋙ G)
  {X' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))}
  (rep : F.RepresentableBy X')
  {Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
  (e : Limits.pullback Y.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') ≅ X'.left)
  (he : e.hom ≫ X'.hom = pullback.snd Y.hom (specMapAlgebra k k'))

noncomputable def gen_quotientIsoOver :
    (Over.pullback (specMapAlgebra k k')).obj Y ⟶ X' :=
  Over.homMk e.hom he

noncomputable def gen_descentMor (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (u : T ⟶ Y) :
    baseTest (k' := k') T ⟶ X' :=
  (Over.pullback (specMapAlgebra k k')).map u ≫ gen_quotientIsoOver e he

theorem gen_descentMor_comp {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (f : T ⟶ T') (g : T' ⟶ Y) :
    gen_descentMor e he T (f ≫ g)
      = ((Over.pullback (specMapAlgebra k k')).map f) ≫ gen_descentMor e he T' g := by
  change (Over.pullback (specMapAlgebra k k')).map (f ≫ g) ≫ gen_quotientIsoOver e he
      = _ ≫ (Over.pullback (specMapAlgebra k k')).map g ≫ gen_quotientIsoOver e he
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  exact Category.assoc _ _ _

noncomputable def gen_descentClass (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (u : T ⟶ Y) :
    G.obj (op ((coverFunctor (k := k) (k' := k')).obj T)) :=
  Φ.hom.app (op (baseTest (k' := k') T)) (rep.homEquiv (gen_descentMor e he T u))

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
theorem gen_descentClass_natural {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    (f : T ⟶ T') (g : T' ⟶ Y) :
    gen_descentClass Φ rep e he T (f ≫ g)
      = ((coverFunctor (k := k) (k' := k')).op ⋙ G).map f.op
          (gen_descentClass Φ rep e he T' g) := by
  have hstep : rep.homEquiv (gen_descentMor e he T (f ≫ g))
      = F.map ((Over.pullback (specMapAlgebra k k')).map f).op
          (rep.homEquiv (gen_descentMor e he T' g)) :=
    (congrArg rep.homEquiv (gen_descentMor_comp e he f g)).trans
      (rep.homEquiv_comp _ _)
  change Φ.hom.app (op (baseTest (k' := k') T))
      (rep.homEquiv (gen_descentMor e he T (f ≫ g))) = _
  rw [hstep]
  exact NatTrans.naturality_apply Φ.hom
    (X := op (baseTest (k' := k') T')) (Y := op (baseTest (k' := k') T))
    ((Over.pullback (specMapAlgebra k k')).map f).op
    (rep.homEquiv (gen_descentMor e he T' g))

end Generic

end PicScheme
end Scheme
end AlgebraicGeometry
EOF
